stem: The charge of a phone battery decreases at a constant rate while a video plays. When the video starts, the battery is at 92 percent. After 3 hours of playing, the battery is at 71 percent. If the charge continues to decrease at this rate, what percent will the battery be at 8 hours after the video starts?
solution: The charge drops \(92 - 71 = 21\) percentage points in 3 hours, or 7 points per hour.
verify:
t = symbols('t')
m = Rational(71 - 92, 3)
B = 92 + m*t
assert m == -7 and B.subs(t, 8) == 36
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [B.subs(t, 8)]
